title: To expand the boundaries of the Atchafalaya National Heritage Area to include Lafourche Parish, Louisiana.
official_summary: This act expands the boundaries of Atchafalaya National Heritage Area to include Lafourche Parish, Louisiana. It also expands the membership of the local coordinating entity to include the parish.

summary.headline: Law adds Lafourche Parish, Louisiana, to the Atchafalaya National Heritage Area and gives the parish a seat on its managing group.
summary.what_it_does: This law expands the Atchafalaya National Heritage Area in Louisiana so that it now includes Lafourche Parish. It also adds Lafourche Parish to the local group that coordinates and manages the heritage area.

who_it_affects.group: Residents and local government of Lafourche Parish, Louisiana
who_it_affects.how: The parish becomes part of the heritage area and gains membership in the local group that coordinates it.

who_it_affects.group: The local coordinating entity for the Atchafalaya National Heritage Area
who_it_affects.how: Its membership grows to include Lafourche Parish.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 23, 2024; the summary does not list a separate start date.
